title: 2022 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: A cricket randomly hops between \(4\) leaves, on each turn hopping to one of the other \(3\) leaves with equal probability. After \(4\) hops, what is the probability that the cricket has returned to the leaf where it started?

solutions.text:
Let \(p_n\) be the probability that the cricket is on its starting leaf after \(n\) hops. We have \(p_0=1\).

If the cricket is on the starting leaf, the next hop must leave it. If the cricket is not on the starting leaf, exactly one of the \(3\) possible hops returns to the start. Therefore \[ p_{n+1}=\frac{1-p_n}{3}. \]

Thus \[ \begin{gathered} p_1=0,\quad p_2=\frac13,\quad p_3=\frac29,\quad \\ p_4=\frac{1-\frac29}{3}=\frac{7}{27}. \end{gathered} \]

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Track only whether the cricket is on the starting leaf
If the cricket is not at the start, the next hop returns with probability \(\frac13\)
